Have you ever tried cooking French Beans this way? This is a simple, Maharashtrian-style French Beans Sabzi, made with a delicious dry masala paste of roasted peanuts, dry coconut and a few other ingredients. It's super quick to put together and tastes absolutely incredible!
I've also shared a recipe for Shengdanyachi Bhindi, where we use the same masala with bhindi, and that one is equally delicious. Do give both recipes a try!
The full written recipe is in the description below.
Happy Cooking!
